title: Snapshot accepted (POST /api/snapshots, 200)
description: Reader: OpenPairings. The answer to an accepted publish, including a byte-identical repeat (which stores nothing new and answers with the existing row). Refusals are error.response.schema.json: 401 unauthorized; 403 key_required, key_mismatch, not_owner, tournament_hidden, installation_suspended, installation_revoked, address_blocked; 410 tournament_deleted; 413 snapshot_too_large (with limit_bytes); 422 not_an_object, wrong_schema, unknown_version, missing_slug, invalid; 429 rate_limited; 503 publishing_paused, storage_low.

received_at.description: The server's clock when the stored row was received, ISO 8601 UTC (microseconds).
